registered_agent_rules: List an agent for service of process and a South Carolina street address; the agent signs the formation form.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: An LLC not taxed as a corporation is exempt from the corporate annual report and License Fee. Corporate tax treatment changes these obligations.
unemployment_insurance_agency: South Carolina Department of Employment and Workforce
plain_english_summary: File articles for 110. An LLC not taxed as a corporation has no corporate annual report or License Fee.
common_mistake: Electing corporate taxation can add annual reporting and License Fee obligations.
notes: Annual-report fields describe an ordinary domestic LLC not taxed as a corporation; its report name, deadline and filing URL are inapplicable. Name-reservation fee, processing time, expedited service, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
